description:
The DevInit configuration for setting up the development environment runs a series of tools in order. First, it invokes **require-nodejs** (no additional input) to make sure that Node.js is available, as noted in the comment “Ensures Node.js is available.” Next, it executes **npm-install** with the input “-g typescript” and the extra flag “--silent” to install TypeScript globally, matching the comment “Install TypeScript globally.” The third step calls **require-dotnetcoresdk** with the input “6.0” to require the .NET 6 SDK, reflecting the comment “Require .NET 6 SDK.” After that, **dotnet-toolinstall** is run with the input “dotnet-ef” and the option “--global” to install the EF Core CLI tool globally, as described by the comment “Install EF Core CLI tool globally.” Finally, the configuration enables the Windows feature **windowsfeature-enable** with the input “Web-Server” to turn on the IIS Web Server feature, per the comment “Enable IIS Web Server feature.”  

Overall, this setup is documented with the comment: “DevInit configuration for setting up development environment.”

run.comments: Install EF Core CLI tool globally.
